mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_tax_calculation (id, source_system, source_object_type, source_object_id, source_object_no, source_revision, tax_scope_key, calculation_stage, supply_kind, business_mode, seller_party_id, buyer_client_id, tax_subject_party_id, acquiring_entity_no, currency, price_mode, tax_point_date, tax_point_basis, status, tax_amount_source, block_reasons_json, net_amount, charged_tax_amount, gross_amount, rounding_amount, expires_at, create_time) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.sourceSystem}, #{row.sourceObjectType}, #{row.sourceObjectId}, #{row.sourceObjectNo}, #{row.sourceRevision}, #{row.taxScopeKey}, #{row.calculationStage}, #{row.supplyKind}, #{row.businessMode}, #{row.sellerPartyId}, #{row.buyerClientId}, #{row.taxSubjectPartyId}, #{row.acquiringEntityNo}, #{row.currency}, #{row.priceMode}, #{row.taxPointDate}, #{row.taxPointBasis}, #{row.status}, #{row.taxAmountSource}, #{row.blockReasonsJson}, #{row.netAmount}, #{row.chargedTaxAmount}, #{row.grossAmount}, #{row.roundingAmount}, #{row.expiresAt}, #{row.createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, source_system, source_object_type, source_object_id, source_object_no, source_revision, tax_scope_key, calculation_stage, supply_kind, business_mode, seller_party_id, buyer_client_id, tax_subject_party_id, acquiring_entity_no, currency, price_mode, tax_point_date, tax_point_basis, status, tax_amount_source, block_reasons_json, net_amount, charged_tax_amount, gross_amount, rounding_amount, expires_at, create_time FROM t_tax_calculation WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, source_system, source_object_type, source_object_id, source_object_no, source_revision, tax_scope_key, calculation_stage, supply_kind, business_mode, seller_party_id, buyer_client_id, tax_subject_party_id, acquiring_entity_no, currency, price_mode, tax_point_date, tax_point_basis, status, tax_amount_source, block_reasons_json, net_amount, charged_tax_amount, gross_amount, rounding_amount, expires_at, create_time FROM t_tax_calculation WHERE source_object_no = #{sourceObjectNo} ORDER BY source_revision, id
